material_findings.title: USA.gov active directory includes xTech|Kinetic Reach after Army submission closure
material_findings.facts: USA.gov labels xTech|Kinetic Reach among active challenges and shows an overall November 30, 2026 end date and $1.5M cash pool. Army primary page explicitly states 'Submission window is closed' and Phase 1 submission June 5–30, 2026; November dates concern later finalist activities. Not a currently open new application.
material_findings.entry_cost: Not independently established; no new submission possible on official page.
material_findings.eligibility: Business applicants and specified readiness requirements; irrelevant until new application window opens.
material_findings.next_action: Keep directory source but add an agency-status cross-check requirement; do not promote the $1.5M as currently accessible.

material_findings.title: ACL Caregiver AI Prize overall 2029 end date does not reopen Phase 1
material_findings.facts: USA.gov shows $2.5M total cash and overall February 6, 2029 end. ACL primary page says Phase 1 applications were due July 31, 2026 and Phase 2/3 dates will be announced later. No currently open phase verified.
material_findings.next_action: Watch ACL's official phase announcements, not the federal directory overall end date.

material_findings.title: #BuildHybridAI 2026 — $10,000 advertised cash, official rules pending
material_findings.facts: Organizer's Devpost overview advertises $10,000 in cash for online hybrid Firebase AI Logic builds. Submissions November 9–30, 2026, closing November 30 at 2:00 PM PST (22:00 UTC). Rules page explicitly says binding rules unavailable until submissions open November 9.
material_findings.eligibility: Overview indicates adult entrants subject to exceptions; binding country/team/AI-tool/IP/payout rules not yet published.
material_findings.authorization: Development competition only; no external security testing.
missing_verification: Reopen binding rules on or after November 9, 2026.
Verify complete eligibility, registration, fee, prize breakdown and payout conditions.
Verify required Firebase features, cost/credits, originality and demo/submission requirements.
Check participant account/access before creating active submission case.
material_findings.deduplication: No canonical item or matching open research PR found by title search; do not promote before rules.

material_findings.title: HackTheFashion Global'26 — advertised $45,000 but binding rules contain placeholders
material_findings.facts: Devpost overview advertises $45,000 cash (three $15,000 winners), student-only eligibility and November 6–25 online event; schedule closes November 25 at 5:00 PM IST (11:30 UTC). Rules contain literal placeholders for sponsor identity, registration/submission dates, API name and prize table; rules also state they require legal review before publication.
missing_verification: Require completed organizer-issued binding rules, verified sponsor identity and actual API access.
Reconcile student-only eligibility with rule text and validate cash payout terms.
Do not treat template text as a valid award contract or create an active case.

material_findings.title: IceHacks 2026 — contradictory Devpost cash headline
material_findings.facts: Devpost structured header says $17,150 in cash while organizer body explicitly states no cash prizes, only sponsor credits/subscriptions/scholarships. Student-only event November 8–15. Do not report $17,150 as available cash.
material_findings.next_action: Require corrected organizer prize metadata and official prize schedule before cash-opportunity promotion.
